voices.name: Reyaansh - Sad, Heartbroken Drama Actor
voices.description: Emotional, vulnerable and tearful — Reyaansh lets a line crack halfway through pain and keeps going anyway, in a low, trembling male tone that sounds like someone holding it together in front of people, the breath catching before the hardest word lands. That raw, quietly breaking delivery suits grief scenes, breakup dialogue, apology monologues, hospital and funeral sequences and tragic character arcs. Ideal for OTT series, audio fiction, narrative games, short films and emotional reels.

voices.name: Reyaansh - Charismatic Marathi Creator
voices.description: Energetic, bold, and impossible to scroll past, Reyaansh carries the energy of a Marathi influencer who owns every frame. His bold, expressive delivery works across Reels, Shorts, brand collaborations, and viral content campaigns where personality and presence drive reach. Perfect for Marathi brands and creators seeking an influencer voice that feels famous before the first word ends.

voices.name: Reyaansh - Interactive Tutor
voices.description: Clear, interactive, and engaging, this English voice teaches by asking the right question, not handing over the answer. Built for exam preparation, concept walkthroughs, doubt-solving sessions, critical-thinking exercises, essay coaching, and one-on-one tutoring content. A strong fit for online course platforms, LMS systems, and ed-tech apps, and for tutoring companies and student-focused learning brands hiring responsive tutors.

voices.name: Reyaansh - Deep Premium Brand Ad
voices.description: Rich, authoritative and commanding — Reyaansh brings a Hindi voice that makes every brand feel bigger than it is. His polished delivery is built for TV advertisements, radio ads, FMCG campaigns, product launches, and brand commercials where a flat voice gets skipped, and a powerful one gets remembered. Perfect for agencies and brands building advertising content.

voices.name: Reyaansh - Calm SDR Outbound Sales
voices.description: Reyaansh brings calm confidence to outbound sales. His tone is smart and approachable — never pushy, always purposeful. He moves conversations forward naturally, making prospects feel informed rather than sold to. Built for lead qualification, product pitches, appointment setting, and consultative sales flows. Ideal for fintech platforms, EdTech sales teams, insurance outbound, SaaS companies, and any business running outbound voice campaigns that need to convert without friction.

voices.name: Reyaansh – Sharp, Smooth & Confident
voices.description: Reyaansh sounds like the friend who actually has good advice — and makes it worth listening to. Clear, polished, and genuinely cool without trying too hard. His tone sits perfectly between wisdom and wit, making life advice feel like a conversation rather than a lecture. Built for social media content, self-improvement reels, lifestyle storytelling, and creator-led commentary. Ideal for coaching platforms, personal brand channels, D2C lifestyle brands, and digital creators.

voices.name: Reyaansh - Polished Facts Reel Voice
voices.description: Reyaansh delivers a polished, neutral Indian English voice built for the modern faceless content creator. His clean, broadcast-ready tone makes facts, trivia, and "Did You Know" scripts sound effortlessly engaging — no regional pull, no distracting accent, just pure clarity. Perfect for faceless YouTube automation channels, infographics-style videos, Shorts narration, and listicle content. Creators scaling multi-topic fact channels love his consistency.

voices.name: Reyaansh – Deep, Gripping Suspense Voice
voices.description: Reyaansh delivers a slow, dramatic, and gripping tone built for suspense and mystery storytelling. His controlled pacing allows tension to build naturally, making scenes feel immersive and psychologically engaging rather than exaggerated. Ideal for thriller narratives, crime stories, dark folklore, suspense reels, and long-form mystery audio series. Performs especially well on platforms like thriller channels, mystery podcasts, and serialized suspense productions.

voices.name: Reyansh - Bright and Agile
voices.description: A high-energy, youthful voice of a young Indian male. It has a light, rhythmic bounce and a modern, tech-savvy clarity that feels both eager and friendly.
